notes: DeepFlux 9.6 - the mini player now opens with an animated logo loop (sound on the first pass, silent loops until you play something or open the full app). Chinese-named IPTV movies get real covers: a new strict title match plus a manual Identify picker and on-demand AI translation on the info panel. IPTV loading got a comfort rework: staged progress bar, chunked grid build (no more freezes on 70k-entry playlists), gentler CPU during loads, instant refreshes when nothing changed. Includes all 9.0-9.5 features.
